scope: D-093/094 and static plan5b derivation + independent short preflight ONLY; no long training, input switch, dynamics, both-stage combined offset, new algorithm or tuning.
offset_provenance: Verbatim EXP007 synthetic stimulus, in normalized input units of EACH stage flash, magnitude0.0005..0.0015 (max0.6% of0.25 flash spacing). No chip extraction, statistical distribution, random offset seed, drift, amplitude scaling or post-result sweep.
models: Copy all3 EXP062 ideal/both_linear/both_smooth models, matched static main/auxiliary. Variants nominal_zero, stage1_only, stage2_only; independent variant definitions, same CDAC and transfer. 9 cases.

grid.scores: unit Q3 and fixed exported inverse for linear cases; exact continuous inverse is offline positive control only. Gate/basis/joint counted separately; paired nominal q1/q2/output/gate change, no SNDR claim.

boundary.first_stage: all8 effective thresholds: t-2^-36,t,t+2^-36 with4 tag pairs; plus working input endpoints+/-0.82. Preserve native-double and exact rational results separately.
boundary.second_stage: standalone matched main/auxiliary node m=t-2^-36,t,t+2^-36 for all8 effective stage2 thresholds, both d2; these nodes are interface controls, not all reachable under actual working input.
boundary.direct_quantizers: nominal/stage1/stage2 vectors, both flash interfaces, threshold equality and immediate double nextafter neighbors; require exact symbol semantics for supplied double thresholds.
boundary.minimal_examples: first-stage ideal x=251/2000,d1=d2=+1; second-stage linear x=1/2400,d1=+1,d2=-1. Exact and double equality may differ only inside declared boundary margin.

short.input: Copy original EXP062 stored30720-period double tone, global counter dither, original Q3/Q1.10/Q22/unit start/old-state gates/synchronous120-slot update; all slots execute/output. No FFT on noncoherent3840-conversion preflight.

verification.all_short_records: Independent scalar double physical source + rational readout/commit, all outputs, masks, correlations, requests and chain states; compare all zero-variant states and output prefix to existing EXP062 nominal records. No nominal long rerun.
verification.mathematical_boundaries: Exact rational model and protected-margin check; retain any exact-vs-double word difference within2e-12 of the affected decision/floor boundary as numeric endpoint exception, never change stored word or source. Require native-double original words exact.
verification.sources: Hash new executable/protocol/test files and all existing src/RTL/EXP057..062 files, copy source profiles before execution. Existing fingerprints verified independently at delivery.

predictions: Small fixed offsets can change local learning gates while ideal final reconstruction cancels changed decisions. Chosen offsets guarantee nominal preamp outputs<=0.631, backend magnitude<=81, zero backend fourth readout basis. Unit front raw bound<384, but no general eight-state front fourth/closed gate theorem. SAR may remove correct-inverse third closed-gate protection; support increase is not a long-run performance guarantee.
next: After short preflight and analysis, freeze necessary same-input long pairs using EXP062 nominal record and unchanged input/seeds/digital/budget/criteria. Do not run larger offsets to force fourth support. First and second offsets separately, no arbitrary combination scan.
freeze: Refuse output overwrite, preserve failed runs/verification. Offsets and ideal input are platform/offline data only. Online production window consumes only DigitalCalibrationSample. No commit/push.
